text: In November 2021, Transportation Staff conducted a study to see if an all-way stop control at the intersection of Chicoutimi Avenue and Frontenac Avenue met the criteria required for installation. The study came back finding that the criteria were not met. However, I have recently spoken to many members of the community who are concerned about the impacts of not having an all-way stop control at this intersection on community safety in the neighbourhood. Traffic has increased with many children and residents attending school and services. Therefore, I am requesting that all-way stop controls be installed at the intersection Chicoutimi Avenue and Frontenac Avenue.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Frontenac Avenue and Chicoutimi Avenue.
